name: prime material plane
lore:
### **Codex Entry: The Prime Material Plane**

**Overview**
The Prime Material Plane is the fulcrum of the multiverse—the fragile, vibrant center where the raw energies of the Inner Planes meet the divine mandates of the Outer Planes. To the common traveler, it is simply "the world," but to the scholar, it is a unique nexus of stability amidst an infinite sea of chaos and law.

**History: The Great Confluence**
Ancient chronicles from the Astral Archive suggest the Prime was born of the "Great Confluence." In the dawning ages, the First Gods sought a canvas upon which to paint their designs. They drew quintessence from the Elemental Planes—fire for warmth, earth for bone—and tempered it with the spiritual essence of the heavens and hells. This "First Forging" created a realm where physical laws hold sway, yet magic remains a potent, if volatile, undercurrent.

**Significance: The Crucible of Choice**
The Prime is the only realm where mortality truly flourishes. Unlike the immortal denizens of the Outer Planes, who are bound by their inherent natures (be they celestial or fiendish), the inhabitants of the Prime possess the gift of Free Will. This makes the plane the ultimate prize; the faith and souls harvested here are the lifeblood of the gods. It is the "Great Filter" where spirits are tested before passing into the eternal beyond.

**Legends: The World-Anchor**
Deep-realm myths whisper of the "World-Anchor," a hidden heart at the core of the Prime that prevents the multiverse from drifting into the void. Some druidic circles maintain that the Prime is not a place, but a "Great Tapestry" being woven by a forgotten Weaver, where every mortal life is a vital thread. Should the Prime fall, the legends warn, the surrounding planes would collapse inward, returning all of existence to the primordial silence.
